Solution 3 is correct. The robot covers 1 km (1000 m) in 2.5 h = 9000 s, so its speed is 1000/9000 = 1/9 m/s. In 90 s it travels (1/9)(90) = 10 m.

Solution 1 uses 2500 m instead of 1000 m, which gives 25 m. Solution 2 miscalculates the speed: 1 km/2.5 h is 0.4 km/h, which is 1/9 m/s, not 0.1 m/s, so it gets 9 m.

CHOICE: 3
